DEBUG
SYMPTOM: PC sprites invisible — they were rendering behind desk sprites.
CAUSE: All bgItems sorted by ty together. PCs have ty = deskRow - 1 (lower row = drawn first), then desk at deskRow draws over them.
FIX: In renderer.ts, split furniture into two passes:
  Pass 1: Draw all desks
  Pass 2: Draw all PCs (on top of desks)
Don't sort them together — explicit ordering.
PREVENT: Any sprite that should appear ON TOP of furniture needs its own render pass after that furniture.
WHERE: src/game/renderer.ts
GOTCHA: Also invalidate buildFurniturePlacements() cache when changing layout — add a version counter or flag to force rebuild.
